title: A structural closure of growth-sector couplings between discrete gravity and cosmology
description: Tests three operator-level ways Energy-Flow Cosmology could couple to the linear growth equation: multiplicative Geff in the Poisson term, additive local friction, and additive non-local (memory) friction. Using DESI DR2 BAO, cosmic-chronometer H(z), fσ8, and EG data, it shows each class is either structurally excluded or degenerate with Ωm once geometry is locked, implying growth-only observables cannot discriminate this theory class and pointing to lensing/slip or cross-correlations as the next informative directions.

This paper tests three operator-level ways for Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) to couple a discrete-gravity prefactor to the linear growth of structure: multiplicative Geff on the Poisson source, additive local friction, and additive non-local (memory) friction. Using DESI DR2 BAO, cosmic-chronometer H(z), an fσ8 compilation, and the EG statistic, it shows each class is either structurally excluded or fully degenerate with Ωm once geometry is locked, implying growth-only observables cannot discriminate this theory class.
author: Morten Magnusson

eq1_growth_LCDM.description: Linear growth equation for matter overdensity in flat ΛCDM, with E(a)=H(a)/H0 and primes denoting d/da.

eq2_Geff.latex: \frac{G_{\rm eff}(k,a)}{G} = 1 + \big(C^2 - 1\big)\, g(a)\, s(k), \quad g(a) = \frac{1}{1+e^{-(a-a_t)/\delta a}}, \quad s(k) = \frac{1}{1+(k/k_\Lambda)^2}
eq2_Geff.description: Class A coupling: multiplicative modification of the Poisson source via a gated, low-pass-screened effective Newton's constant.

eq3_local_friction.description: Class B coupling: additive, gate-activated local friction β g(a)/a on the velocity term; source term unchanged.

eq4_memory_kernel.latex: G(a) = \int_0^a g(a')\,da' = \delta a\,\ln\!\big(1 + e^{(a-a_t)/\delta a}\big) - \ln\!\big(1 + e^{-a_t/\delta a}\big)
eq4_memory_kernel.description: Class C coupling: time-accumulated gate (memory kernel) producing non-local friction β G(a)/a that breaks Markovian evolution.

eq5_background.description: Flat ΛCDM background expansion used in all classes for the structural test.

eq6_EG_statistic.description: Quasi-static EG statistic; for growth-only modifications with \Sigma=1 it reduces to \Omega_{m,0}/f(z), containing no information independent of fσ8 once \Omega_{m,0} is fixed.

key_results.main_finding: All three tested coupling classes (multiplicative Geff, local friction, non-local memory friction) are either structurally excluded by the data or absorbed by the Ωm–coupling degeneracy once geometry is locked by BAO+H(z); EG with Σ=1 adds no information beyond fσ8.
parameters_tested: Σ (lensing response; fixed to 1 in growth-only tests)
key_results.author: Morten Magnusson

linear_growth_lcdm.description: Baseline linear growth equation for matter overdensity in flat ΛCDM, written in scale factor a, with Hubble-normalized expansion E(a).

multiplicative_geff.latex: \frac{G_{\mathrm{eff}}(k,a)}{G} = 1 + (C^2 - 1)\, g(a)\, s(k),\quad g(a) = \left[1 + e^{-(a-a_t)/\delta a}\right]^{-1},\quad s(k) = \left[1 + (k/k_\Lambda)^2\right]^{-1}
multiplicative_geff.description: Class A coupling: a logistic temporal gate and low-pass Fourier screening modulate an effective gravitational coupling that multiplies the Poisson source term in the growth equation.

local_friction.description: Class B coupling: an additive, gate-activated local friction term proportional to β modifies the velocity (first-derivative) coefficient; the Poisson source is unmodified.

memory_kernel.latex: G(a) = \int_0^{a} g(a')\,\mathrm{d}a' = \delta a\,\ln\!\left(\frac{1 + e^{(a-a_t)/\delta a}}{1 + e^{-a_t/\delta a}}\right),\quad \text{friction} \propto \beta\,\frac{G(a)}{a}
memory_kernel.description: Class C coupling: a non-local (in time) friction term built from the integrated gate kernel G(a), which delays and smooths the modification relative to the instantaneous gate g(a).

background_expansion.description: ΛCDM background expansion used for Classes B and C, and adopted here also for Class A to isolate source-side effects.

eg_statistic.latex: E_G(z) = \frac{\Sigma(z)\,\Omega_{m,0}}{f(z)}\,,\quad f(z) = \frac{\mathrm{d}\ln D}{\mathrm{d}\ln a},\quad \Sigma=1\ \text{for growth-only modifications}
eg_statistic.description: Quasi-static EG statistic; for pure growth-sector modifications with no lensing/slip (Σ=1) it reduces to Ωm,0/f(z), i.e., it carries no information independent of fσ8.

key_results.main_finding: All three tested growth-sector coupling classes (multiplicative Geff, additive local friction, additive non-local memory friction) are either structurally excluded by the data or fully absorbed by the Ωm–coupling degeneracy once geometry is fixed by BAO+H(z); EG with Σ=1 adds no information beyond fσ8.

Sound horizon rd fixed to Planck 2018

fσ8 compilation: 6dFGS, SDSS MGS, BOSS DR12 (3 z with covariance), VIPERS, FastSound

sealed_predictions.statement: In the quasi-static regime with Σ=1 and geometry anchored by BAO+H(z), EG(z) provides no independent constraining power beyond fσ8(z) because EG = Ωm,0 / f(z).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: A joint analysis showing that adding EG data shifts or tightens growth constraints relative to fσ8-only beyond what is implied by the Ωm prior from BAO+H(z).

sealed_predictions.statement: Any apparent preference for a non-zero local friction β from fσ8-only fits will disappear when imposing the BAO-anchored Ωm prior.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: A BAO+H(z)-anchored growth analysis that still finds β ≠ 0 at ≥3σ, robust to survey covariances and σ8/H0 priors.

kill_criteria: KC1: Demonstrate that, with Σ=1 and Ωm fixed by BAO+H(z), adding EG measurements leads to a statistically significant (e.g., >3σ) improvement in growth constraints beyond fσ8-only expectations, contradicting EG = Ωm,0/f(z).
KC2: Find a robust (≥3σ) non-zero best-fit β in Class B (local friction) that persists under a BAO+H(z)-anchored Ωm prior and full growth-data covariances.
KC3: Show that Class C (non-local memory friction) yields a stable preference (e.g., Δχ² ≤ −9 for one extra parameter) without degrading BAO/H(z) fits, after marginalizing over Ωm, σ8, and H0.

KC4: Establish that a multiplicative Geff with C ≈ 2.32 and a physically reasonable k_Λ fits the joint growth dataset while remaining consistent with BAO+H(z), contradicting the paper’s structural exclusion of this class under fixed background.

KC5: Provide a data-driven counterexample where growth-only observables, with geometry locked, distinguish between at least two operator classes at ≥3σ, refuting the paper’s claim that growth alone is insufficient.
kill_criteria.statement: For growth-only modifications with no lensing/slip (Σ=1), EG(z) will always reduce to Ωm,0/f(z) and thus cannot add independent constraining power beyond fσ8 once Ωm is set by BAO+H(z).
kill_criteria.falsifiable_by: A joint fσ8 + EG analysis (with Σ fixed to 1 and BAO+H(z)-locked Ωm) that yields statistically independent constraints from EG beyond those from fσ8 alone.

kill_criteria.statement: Apparent preferences for a nonzero local or memory-friction amplitude β seen in fσ8-only fits will disappear when the Ωm prior from BAO+H(z) is imposed.
kill_criteria.falsifiable_by: A growth-only dataset that, after imposing the BAO+H(z)-locked Ωm prior, still detects β ≠ 0 at high significance in Class B or C.

kill_criteria: KC1: A robust joint growth–lensing analysis that, with BAO+H(z)-locked geometry and minimal modeling, measures EG(z) inconsistent with Ωm,0/f(z) at >5σ (i.e., effectively Σ ≠ 1 in the relevant redshift range), falsifying the growth-only EFC coupling bridge tested here.

KC2: Sub-percent precision fσ8(z) measurements over 0.1 < z < 1 that, when combined with DESI-like BAO and CC H(z) and with galaxy–lensing and RSD–lensing cross-correlations, rule out (at >5σ) all three operator pathways (multiplicative Geff with screened form, local friction, non-local memory friction), thereby excluding any viable projection of the discrete-gravity prefactor C ≈ 2.32 into linear growth.

KC3: An independent Grid-AQUAL reanalysis demonstrating that the discrete-gravity prefactor is inconsistent with C ≈ 2.32 (e.g., |C − 1| < 0.1 at high confidence), removing the amplitude needed for any EFC cosmological growth coupling and killing this bridge.

KC4: Detection of a scale dependence in linear growth that is incompatible with the screened form s(k) = [1 + (k/k_Λ)^2]^{-1} (e.g., a blue-tilted enhancement or a sign change across linear k) at high significance, falsifying the specific multiplicative Geff structure considered.
